load.title: Open a .holo archive and verify its footer, every content-blob label and the manifest cross-references

inspect.title: Describe an archive without running it: sections, dual digests, manifest, model and provenance, as prismpm/holo-inspection/1

vectors.title: Dispatch every acceptance vector the model carries through the Core-Wasm guest and compare byte for byte

history.title: Write the acceptance vectors as a prism/history/1 history

replay.title: Re-execute recorded histories against a build, report every divergence and write the prism/replay/v1 statement, with exit codes 0, 1 and 2

check.title: Judge an archive against a policy and return a prism/verdict/1 with its assurance level, with exit codes 0, 1 and 2

world.title: Report the WIT world the archive declares and whether the guest conforms, and judge the pure-world and pinned-contract policies

attestations.title: Report the attestation section: absent in an archive of revision 2026-10-23, listed when present, and withholding a verdict until a revision admits it
